title: Cartwise Shopper Batches — Batch Size, Route and Offer Limits Schedule
content:
Each of the six batch types of Cartwise Shopper Batches carries its own limits on how many customer orders a batch holds, how many item units it may carry, how long its estimated route may run, how long its offer stays open and how soon shopping must start after acceptance. The figures below are the schedule values for every batch type.

| Batch type | Orders per batch | Shopper delivers the orders | Item units at most | Estimated route at most (miles) | Offer open for (seconds) | Shopping must start within (minutes of acceptance) | In-app ID scan before alcohol hand-over |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | 1 | No (shop and stage only) | 60 | 0.0 | 60 | 30 | Not required |
| Express 30 Batch | 1 | Yes | 25 | 3.0 | 30 | 10 | Required |
| Single Delivery Batch | 1 | Yes | 150 | 25.0 | 60 | 45 | Required |
| Double Delivery Batch | 2 | Yes | 200 | 30.0 | 60 | 45 | Required |
| Triple Delivery Batch | 3 | Yes | 240 | 35.0 | 60 | 45 | Required |
| Stock-Up Batch | 1 | Yes | 300 | 30.0 | 90 | 60 | Required |

## Reading the columns

- **Orders per batch** — the customer orders the batch carries; a batch carries at most this many.
- **Shopper delivers the orders** — "No" means the shopper shops the order and stages it for pickup or handoff; the batch never passes through a delivering stage.
- **Item units at most** and **estimated route at most** — the largest number of item units, and the longest estimated route, a batch of that type is offered with. A Shop-Only Batch carries no route.
- **Offer open for** — an offer not accepted within this many seconds passes to another shopper and creates no batch.
- **Shopping must start within** — counted in minutes from the acceptance time; a batch whose shopping has not started by then is released as dropped with the reason "not started".
- **In-app ID scan** — where required, alcohol is handed over only after the ID scan in the shopper app.

## Points drawn from the table

- The Express 30 Batch has the shortest offer window (30 seconds) and the shortest start window (10 minutes); the Stock-Up Batch has the longest of both (90 seconds and 60 minutes).
- Only the Double Delivery Batch and the Triple Delivery Batch carry more than one order (2 and 3 respectively).
- Hypothetical illustration: a Single Delivery Batch accepted at 14:00 whose shopping has not started by 14:45 has reached the end of its 45-minute start window.
